title: DropLine Connect Four Lite - First Task QC
subtitle: Version 4.0.0 full-stack rewrite reviewed before upload-rule validation
note: Fresh static QC on 2026-09-01. No current v4 Harbor runs exist. Docker Desktop was unavailable locally; host-isolated API and Playwright Chromium smoke suites passed.

tasks.name: DropLine Lite
tasks.headline: No static P0-P3 defects found; source and golden behavior are ready for upload checks, while Oracle and reward-calibration gates remain pending evidence.

blocks.title: Static checks passed
items: Required Harbor files and five judge directories are present; all TOML and JSON parse.
The short brief, five split Markdown contracts, two-tab seed workbook, golden solution, judges, and coverage map agree on stack, paths, demo accounts, gameplay, persistence, and accessibility.
All 15 judge criteria are unique and mapped from 11 stated requirements; no unknown or unmapped criterion IDs remain.
Render and Constraints use 5.88% of dimension weight, below the 10% cheap-gate ceiling.
Reward zero is written before launch and preserved by the EXIT trap on launch or judge failure.
No task-local secrets, generated databases, logs, node_modules, context notes, QC reports, or absolute host paths were found.
Pinned Codex, Playwright MCP, RewardKit, Express, better-sqlite3, Python packages, and tagged Docker bases are declared.

blocks.title: Golden behavior passed
items: API smoke passed invalid login, protected access, both seeded accounts, bearer invalidation after sign-out, account isolation, gravity, all four win directions, both colors, terminal locking, exact draw, score deltas, and durable reads.

Playwright smoke passed sign-in, identity, exact 42-cell and seven-control render, rapid-click serialization, reload restoration, keyboard focus, same-origin-only traffic, 375px overflow, and sign-out.
Desktop and 375px win-state screenshots were visually inspected with no clipping, overlap, blank canvas, or incoherent layout.

blocks.title: Pending before delivery
items: Run the separate upload-rule validator next; this report intentionally precedes it.
Build both Docker images once Docker Desktop is available to confirm image-stage behavior.
Run Oracle and require at least 0.95, then rescore the same rollout three times.
Run no-op and at least two adversarial wrong solutions, then collect at least eight rollout rewards for separation and variance checks.
Do not mark Ready for delivery until scorecard hard gates C1, C2, C3, and E1 have run evidence.
